items.t: Timing chain rattle from worn tensioners and guides
items.job: Replace timing chain guides and tensioners (both banks)
items.note: The Autopian cites about $7,500 at an independent specialist for this job on the 5.0L V8.

items.t: Fuel smell from cracked fuel tank flange (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank outlet flange under recall

items.t: Passenger airbag inflator may rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag assembly under recall

items.t: Driver airbag may not deploy correctly (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module under recall

items.t: Rotary gear selector won't rise or turn
items.job: Diagnose and replace rotary transmission selector module
items.note: Sometimes a software update fixes it without new parts.

items.t: Coolant leak from water pump
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Water pump failure on supercharged V6
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Coolant leaks from expansion tank or coolant pipes
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank or leaking coolant pipe
items.note: Pipes buried under the intake take the longest.

items.t: Supercharger rattle at idle
items.job: Install supercharger drive isolator kit
items.note: If the supercharger itself is worn, replacement costs several thousand dollars.

items.t: Dashboard leather bubbling or shrinking
items.job: Re-cover or replace dashboard top
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $3,000 at a dealer.

items.t: Engine shutting off while driving
items.job: Diagnose and update engine control software

items.t: Hard starting or rough idle from clogged injectors
items.job: Clean or replace fuel injectors

items.t: Battery drain and charging warnings
items.job: Test charging system, tighten or replace battery cable, replace battery if needed
items.note: RepairPal lists about $435-$465 for a battery on 2009-2011 cars.

items.t: Weak air conditioning from compressor clutch
items.job: A/C diagnosis and compressor clutch repair

items.t: Touchscreen and Bluetooth glitches
items.job: Update infotainment software

items.t: LED tail lights failing from corrosion
items.job: Replace rear LED lamp assembly

items.t: Rusty rear subframe
items.job: Replace rear subframe

items.t: Transfer case flange oil leak on AWD cars
items.job: Reseal transfer case flange and top up oil

items.t: Rear differential pinion seal leak
items.job: Replace rear differential pinion seal

items.t: Coolant and oil leaks around the supercharger
items.job: Replace coolant pipes or oil cooler gaskets under the supercharger
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,760-$2,260 for an XF oil cooler replacement.

items.t: Timing chain wear on 2.0L diesel
items.job: Replace timing chain kit

items.t: Door lock actuator failure
items.job: Replace door lock actuator

items.t: Water leaking into cabin or trunk
items.job: Find and seal water leak, clear drains and dry carpets

items.t: Infotainment freezing and Bluetooth drops
items.job: Update infotainment software

items.t: Weak 12V battery causing random faults
items.job: Replace 12V battery and register it to the car
items.note: RepairPal lists about $600-$630 for the XF.

items.t: Hooting noise from transmission cooler pipes
items.job: Fit revised foam pads to oil cooler bracket

items.t: Instrument cluster can go blank (recall)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software under recall

items.t: Cracked sill could rupture fuel lines (recall)
items.job: Inspect sill under recall (buyback if cracked)

items.t: Fuel rail end caps leaking (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail under recall

items.t: Airbags may deploy incorrectly on Sportbrake (recall)
items.job: Update airbag software under recall

items.t: Seat belt may not secure a child seat (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace seat belt assemblies under recall

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioners may be damaged (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front seat belts under recall
